data.standardized_narrative: At 31 December 2020 the Syndicate's opening gross claims outstanding (comparative) was $278.823m. Using the gross claims development triangle the Syndicate shows a net adverse prior-year development of approximately $64.0m (23% of opening reserves), i.e. a strengthening of reserves. The deterioration is driven largely by development on older years (closed years 2009-2017 and 2018) including catastrophe losses (notably Hurricanes Florence and Michael affecting 2018) and COVID-19 related impacts (including COVID-related losses affecting prior years and an LPT arrangement). The syndicate reports specific smaller prior-year adverse movements in claims incurred (e.g. $1.1m prior-accident-year adverse claims incurred) but the gross triangle-derived movement across older underwriting years is the primary source for the gross prior-year strengthening reported here.

The 2020 calendar year GAAP result is a loss of US$131.7m (2019: a profit of US$23.4m) and a combined ratio of 171.5% (2019: 87.9%). The COVID-19 pandemic has had wide ranging impacts across multiple underwriting years primarily on Contingency business.
Catastrophe losses of $14.5 million, primarily from Hurricanes Florence and Michael affected the result for the year.
There was adverse development on Crisis Management lines with $2.6m of COVID related losses during the 2020 calendar year.
In the calendar year there was a prior accident year adverse development of claims incurred of $1.1 million (2019: $5.1 million adverse).

data.data_quality_notes: Prior-year development (PYD) gross figure was not provided explicitly as a gross single-line movement in the notes. PYD was computed from the gross claims development triangle (page 32) excluding the two most recent underwriting years (2019, 2020) per the prescribed triangle method. The report also includes an explicit sentence stating a prior-accident-year adverse development of $1.1m (claims incurred) which is a different (P&L) measure and not the gross reserve movement used here. Some COVID-19 amounts quoted in the narrative are net of reinsurance (e.g. $5.6m net on 2017 YOA); where only net figures were quoted they were not used as the primary gross PYD source. All monetary values are reported in the native currency of the financial statements (USD) and are expressed in millions. The gross claims development triangle is presented in $'000 in the report and has been converted to millions here.
